'''Operation Morning Crest''' was an [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] operation overseen by [[Keeper (Imperial Intelligence)|Keeper]] in [[3645 BBY]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The events of the operation were considered an anomaly to Intelligence, and it was not until four years later that they discovered the involvement of the [[Star Cabal]] and understood the meaning of a recording that had been accidentally intercepted during the operation. The recording was a transmission by [[Hunter (Star Cabal)|Hunter]] to her superiors in the Star Cabal, communicating her success in infiltrating the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]].<ref name="The Hidden Throne">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|The Hidden Throne|Isen Four}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Operation Starbender was first mentioned in Keeper's biography on the official site for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and it was further expanded on in the [[Imperial Agent]] mission "The Hidden Throne."
